title: Separate intentional differences from uncontrolled drift
method: Synthetic 60-property comparison: unexplained=5/60=8.3%; all differences=15/60=25%. Counts do not estimate defect likelihood or prove environment equivalence.
alt: Separate intentional differences from uncontrolled drift: Matching 45 properties, Deliberate difference 10 properties, Unexplained difference 5 properties. Illustrative inputs.
